Paychex Flex: Payroll and HR Software in One Platform

Paychex Flex is an all-in-one payroll and HR platform designed to help businesses manage payroll, hiring, employee benefits, time and attendance, and workforce reporting. In this video, you'll see how employers can process payroll in just a few clicks, streamline hiring and onboarding, and gain business insights through payroll analytics and reporting. Employees can access self-service tools to update personal information, review pay details, manage direct deposit, and clock in and out through the Paychex Flex mobile experience. Whether you're looking to simplify payroll processing or build a more efficient HR operation, Paychex Flex gives businesses the tools to save time and support growth.

Topics:

  • 0:00 – Paychex Flex Dashboard Overview
  • 0:28 – Hiring Tools and Analytics
  • 0:37 – Electronic New Hire Onboarding
  • 0:44 – HR and Benefits Administration
  • 1:02 – Time Attendance and Payroll Management
  • 1:36 – Employee Self Service Features

<p id="transcript-button">View Transcript</p>

Paychex Flex Dashboard Overview

0:04 Let's look at how Paychex Flex can help you simplify payroll and HR so you have more time to focus on your business. From the company dashboard, you have access to your current and last payroll, including total cash required, quick answers to review info like your most recent payroll journal, and employee records where you can view employee details like rates and check stubs.

Hiring Tools and Analytics

0:32 In hiring, you can publish openings to career sites and social media and drill down with interactive analytics.

Electronic New Hire Onboarding

0:41 Employees can also complete new hire forms electronically for a totally paperless experience.

HR and Benefits Administration

0:47 In HR, you can store key documentation, track training, and manage performance reviews on any schedule. Simplify open enrollment and compile key data for health care regulations in Benefits Administration.

Time Attendance and Payroll Management

1:05 With Time and Attendance, you can offer flexible punch options and review activity from your dashboard with real-time analytics. You can run payroll on any desktop or mobile device, or import data, edit individual checks, review info like total checks and hours, and access payroll reports in multiple formats. You can also access 160 plus reports for insights on your workforce costs or build your own reports with custom analytics.

Employee Self Service Features

1:40 Under My Account, employees can review check stubs, punch in and out, and update their direct deposit information. Paychex Flex is all about making your payroll and HR tasks effortless all in one platform.

Simplify Payroll and HR Management

Manage payroll processing, employee records, hiring, benefits administration, time tracking, reporting, and employee self-service through one connected platform.

Explore Paychex Flex
